title: Secret comparison using a constant-time equality check
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the early length return as a timing leak, or ask why not ===. === short-circuits on the first differing byte and leaks the match prefix through timing, so timingSafeEqual is required; it throws on unequal lengths, so lengths are compared first, which leaks only the secret's length (not its content) and is the documented, standard guard for this API. Non-string inputs fail closed.
